notes.title: Adam Waste change log v1.01 || Feedback program
notes.content:
Welcome to new Adam Waste! 

We invite you to shape the future of all 5 episodes of Adam Waste with us! Play the demo or the full game [b]today[/b] and let us know of your thoughts, ideas and encountered bugs at feedback@blackturn.com

Your experience is very important to us!

As a thank you gift, we're working on a [b]FREE[/b] weapon DLC for all the testers and the best and most dedicated members of our community will receive a free Adam Waste copy, with all 5 episodes unlocked, as they release.

Let's create something amazing together!

[b]Change log v1.01[/b]

+ Modified AI behaviour
+ AI health changes
+ Added weapon zoom
+ Movement improvements
+ Camera update
+ Collision event improvements
+ Bug fixes
